dawn.flowCheckFigureDesc: Review the figure shown at the top
dawn.flowSelectSlotDesc: Tap the correct slot on the timeline board below
dawn.flowLivesDesc: Lose 1 on wrong answer, game over at 0

labyrinth.label: Labyrinth
labyrinth.description: Seek the reclusive sage and recruit them
labyrinth.headerSub: Examine the traces of six sages to discover the one you seek.
labyrinth.startTrackingDesc: Inquire among 6 sages to find the one you seek
labyrinth.rulesDesc: A game of examining traces from 6 sages to discover the one you seek
labyrinth.rulesIntro: <game>Labyrinth</game> is a game where you discover the one you seek among 6 sages. Confirm that someone is not the one <x>(X)</x> to unlock new traces. When confident, recruit the one you seek <o>(O)</o>.
labyrinth.clue1Desc: 1 content review — revealed at game start
labyrinth.tip1: Click a sage card to reveal <o>O</o> (recruit) and <x>X</x> (confirm) buttons. Each confirmation unlocks a new trace, so gather traces to narrow down the sages.
labyrinth.tip2: You can recruit at any time, but the fewer confirmations with a correct guess, the better. A wrong guess causes the sage to vanish. Judge carefully.

hegemony.label: Hegemony
hegemony.description: Engage in strategic battles with celeb cards
hegemony.headerSub: Strategically place cards to defeat your opponent.
hegemony.rulesDesc: A strategy game where you recruit historical figures and clash each round
hegemony.rulesIntro: <game>Hegemony</game> is a strategy game where you recruit historical figures and issue orders to clash simultaneously each round. Appoint a captain, read fate, master matchups, and reduce your opponent's power to 0.

rules.draftNote: 3 cards are revealed per batch, you alternately pick 2 and discard 1. First pick alternates each batch for fairness. You can <accent>reshuffle</accent> before your first pick.
rules.powerDesc: Acts as HP. Reaching 0 means <red>instant defeat</red>. Only recoverable through governance.
rules.moraleDesc: Reaching 0 triggers a <red>revolt</red>. Excess converts to power damage, increasing as rounds progress.
rules.ordersIntro: Each round, select <white>1 card</white> from your hand and assign one of 3 orders. Both sides reveal <accent>simultaneously</accent> for matchup resolution.
rules.matchupDesc: Winning matchup: effect <accent>x1.5</accent>, opponent effect <red>nullified</red>. Same order clash: only higher aptitude takes effect.
rules.captainIntro: After draft, appoint <accent>1 captain (commander)</accent> from your 5 cards. The captain supports allies from hand or deploys with devastating power.
rules.captainAuraDesc: While captain is in hand, deployed card gets <accent>+15%</accent> aptitude
rules.captainDeployDesc: Captain's own aptitude <accent>x1.5</accent> when deployed (aura lost)
rules.captainLostDesc: Aura disappears when captain goes to discard pile
rules.cardConsumeDesc: Cards used for <red>Battle</red> and <purple>Scheme</purple> go to discard. <amber>Govern</amber> keeps the card in hand.
rules.cardRecoveryDesc: When using <amber>Govern</amber>, select 1 card from discard to return to hand. This always triggers regardless of matchup loss.
rules.cardExhaustDesc: When hand is empty, <accent>1 random card</accent> auto-recovers from discard. If neither side has cards, the game ends and winner is decided by power.
rules.fateIntro: Each round, one <amber>Fate</amber> activates. If your order matches fate, aptitude is boosted to <amber>x1.5</amber>.
rules.fateNote: Fate order is randomized at game start, and the same fate never appears consecutively.
rules.tipBattleMoraleDesc: Battle is powerful but always costs morale -3. Consecutive battles cause morale to plummet, increasing revolt risk. Manage morale with governance and time your attacks.
rules.tipGovernValueDesc: Governance doesn't consume cards and recovers from discard. But it gives the opponent a free turn, so don't overuse it. Aligning with fate makes it a powerful recovery.
rules.tipReadOpponentDesc: If opponent's morale is low, expect governance — counter with battle. If they spam battle, nullify with scheme. Predicting their choice after checking fate is key.
rules.tipAptitudeDesc: Each card has different aptitudes per order. Assign high battle aptitude cards to battle, high intellect cards to scheme. Check the star rating at the bottom of each card.

three_kingdoms.name: Three Kingdoms
three_kingdoms.subtitle: Three nations clash for supremacy over the Central Plains
three_kingdoms.desc: After the fall of the Later Han, three heroes — Cao Cao, Liu Bei, and Sun Quan — vie for dominance. To the west, forces inheriting Qin Shi Huang's legacy watch for opportunities. Gather talents and unify the realm.
three_kingdoms.cand1: Gathering talents with righteousness in Shu, harboring dreams of restoring the Han dynasty.
three_kingdoms.cand2: The hegemon of the Central Plains. Commands the realm with cold strategy and bold ambition.
three_kingdoms.cand3: The Tiger of Jiangdong. Builds an empire on the foundation left by his father and brother.

crusades.name: Crusades
crusades.subtitle: A clash of East and West over the Holy Land
crusades.desc: Across the Mediterranean, Crusader and Islamic forces collide. Who will control the Holy City of Jerusalem? Ottoman ambitions stir in Constantinople, and Eastern European lords refuse to stand idle.
crusades.objective: Secure the Holy Land (Cairo) and eliminate 3+ rival factions
crusades.cand1: Richard the Lionheart. Leads a great army on crusade to reclaim the Holy Land.
crusades.cand2: Defender of Islam. Protects the Holy Land with mercy and martial prowess.

sengoku.name: Sengoku
sengoku.subtitle: Who shall unite the realm?
sengoku.desc: The Japanese archipelago enters the Warring States period. Oda Nobunaga, Tokugawa Ieyasu, Takeda Shingen — three warlords contest for supremacy while heroes rise across East Asia.
sengoku.cand1: The Demon King. Topples the old order through innovation and destruction.
sengoku.cand2: The embodiment of patience. Seizes the realm after enduring wait.
sengoku.cand3: The Tiger of Kai. Overwhelms enemies under the banner of Wind, Forest, Fire, Mountain.

napoleonic.name: Napoleonic Wars
napoleonic.subtitle: The flames of revolution sweep across Europe
napoleonic.desc: Napoleon rises amidst the flames of the French Revolution. Wellington of Britain opposes him, while Bismarck of Prussia and Russian giants eye European hegemony. The great clash between old and new order begins.
napoleonic.cand1: Child of the revolution. Harbors the ambition to establish a new order across all of Europe.
napoleonic.cand2: The Iron Duke. Stakes the prestige of the British Empire to halt France's ambitions.

mongol_empire.name: Mongol Empire
mongol_empire.subtitle: The steppe lord rides toward the world
mongol_empire.desc: Genghis Khan unifies the steppes and embarks on world conquest. Forces inheriting Tang Taizong's legacy control the western regions, while Zhu Yuanzhang prepares his northern campaign from the south. Who shall rule the Eurasian continent?
mongol_empire.cand1: The Great Khan. Born on horseback, conquers the world on horseback.
mongol_empire.cand2: Heavenly Khan. Harbors the great ambition to extend Tang glory to the western regions.
